# Audio fixture

jfk.wav is the 11-second public JFK speech excerpt distributed with whisper.cpp at the pinned source revision in native/model_registry.json. SHA256: 59dfb9a4acb36fe2a2affc14bacbee2920ff435cb13cc314a08c13f66ba7860e.
